hide From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia English folk song "Cold Blow And The Rainy Night" Song Genre English folk song " Cold Blow and a Rainy Night" (also known as " Cold Haily Windy Night", Let Me In This Ae Nicht" , or "The Laird o’ Windy Wa's ") is an English folk song which has been recorded by numerous musicians and musical groups, including James Bowie (Blind Jimmie), [ 1 ] Jeannie Robertson , [ 2 ] Steeleye Span , [ 3 ] Martin Carthy , [ 4 ] Planxty , [ 5 ] and the Exiles . [ 6 ] It is a typical "night-visiting song". [ 1 ] The song has been documented through EFDSS [ 7 ] and Mainly Norfolk. [ 1 ] The song has been recorded by Jon Boden and Oli Steadman for inclusion in their respective lists of daily folk songs " A Folk Song A Day " [ 8 ] and "365 Days Of Folk".
